title: Module 4: Rigid Body Impulse and Angular Momentum
description: Apply linear and angular impulse-momentum principles to rigid bodies, use conservation of angular momentum about a fixed point, and analyze eccentric impact with the coefficient of restitution at the contact point.
learning_objectives: Apply linear impulse-momentum to the center of mass of a rigid body.
Apply angular impulse-momentum about the center of mass and about a fixed point, choosing the correct moment of inertia.
Identify when linear or angular momentum is conserved during an impact, recognizing impulsive constraint reactions.
Solve eccentric-impact problems using contact-point velocities and the coefficient of restitution along the impact line.
